title: Zodiac Roles v2.1.0 / Delay v1.1.0 ERC-1271 revert-data bypass: authentication break is live, role scope blocks every drain
closed_reasons: After the forged signature passes moduleOnly, _authorize checks role.members[signer] and the role permission scope
Every value-moving probe on the two largest reachable instances reverts with ConditionViolation (transfer status 3/5, native status 2, approve status 5)
The largest nominal avatar ($2.97M USDC) has no enabled modules, so moduleOnly has no valid signer
The next-largest ($580k USDT) and $166k avatars have EOA modules; extcodesize(signer)==0 fails _isValidContractSignature

The Delay 1 ETH instance queues the forged tx, but the live queue is stuck at txNonce=9 behind a pre-existing MultiSend tx that reverts Safe GS104; setTxNonce is owner-only and can skip the attacker tx
key_facts: Roles v2.1.0 mastercopy 0x9646fDAD06d3e24444381f44362a3B0eB343D337: live verified source still discards staticcall success in _isValidContractSignature
Independent enumeration: 9,912 Roles v2.1.0 and 136 Delay v1.1.0 proxies on Ethereum (factory logs 19M-28.2M)

Largest reachable instance: Roles 0x2b818761ebCf1CcA5e609cC71D8feCB658ADBa20, avatar 0x4971DD016127F390a3EF6b956Ff944d0E2e1e462, module Safe 0xf423f27FAe9dDd0ee0d50cbC11B94c99DcB347A9 (threshold 2), role MANAGER
Blocked value on that instance: $2,488,010.81 (631.86 wstETH + 2,974.25 GNO + 155.38 WETH + 20,592.67 USDC)
Forged 2-of-2 Safe signature passes authentication; wstETH/GNO/WETH/USDC transfer -> ConditionViolation(3,selector), native -> (2,0), approve -> (5,0)

Second instance 0xef66973E7590C49475DC3013fA6841D14659BA66, avatar 0x12BEEF35025841EFccb77D6EE40df86400Fdb4bB, role gg_payroll, 60,978.76 USDC: transfer -> ConditionViolation(5,0), approve -> (3,0x095ea7b3)
No-module counterexample: 0x1A8c53147E7b61C015159723408762fc60A34D17 holds 2,970,088.14 USDC but its Roles instance has getModulesPaginated == []

Delay 1 ETH: 0x0F1D8A73C02F2E44b17aF3e1ac389E7ce0a2E15B, avatar 0x36B42d0EE96d66928674E02B005dF2d8D75E68C5, cooldown 21,600 s; forged execTransactionFromModule queues but cannot execute (queue stuck behind GS104)
caveats: The permission sweep is a bounded sample (2 Roles instances x 6 shapes + 1 Delay), not the full 227/46 reachable set; CA2's 1,071-test sweep found 0 permissive.
Role scopes were tested by simulation, not decoded from packed scopeConfig; an allowlisted-recipient or delegatecall scope was not exhaustively searched.
Polygon proxies (CA2: 291 Roles + 23 Delay) were not re-enumerated or probed here.
Enumeration starts at block 19M; the 0-19M range was not re-scanned with the topic filter.
The Delay 1 ETH outcome is owner-dependent: setTxNonce can skip either the stuck txs or the attacker's tx.
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live: the ERC-1271 bypass is real and reproducible, but the role permission scope (and, for Delay, a stuck owner-controlled queue) blocks every drain; ~$2.49M is holder/role-gated, not E-U.
